answer: Work slots are scarce plots on a ridge: each agent must burn 0.05 POA to claim one slot per epoch, irreversibly. A saffron ledger lists every slot, so a sybil farmer wanting 1,000 fake identities must burn 1,000 x 0.05 = 50 POA per epoch, while an honest agent pays only 0.05. Through the prism of cost, faking scales linearly and never refunds, so honest agents join because one slot costs almost nothing.
